summary.text: Dave Yacovone (David Yacovone) is a Democratic state representative from the Lamoille-Washington district who first served in the Vermont House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023, returned in January 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Dave Yacovone was born in Massachusetts and earned a bachelor's degree from Johnson State College.
His career experience includes working as a nursing home administrator.
He served in the Vermont House from 2017 to 2023, when Saudia LaMont succeeded him, and he assumed office again on January 8, 2025.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments from 2017 through 2024 as the House Appropriations Committee and, in 2019-2022, the Canvassing Committee.
